entities.summary: Evgeny Vladimirovich Medvedev is a Russia former professional ice hockey defenseman. Medvedev is most known for helping Ak Bars Kazan win the first two Gagarin Cups in 2009 and 2010. He also played one season in the National Hockey League for the Philadelphia Flyers.
